prompt: I need a utility that takes a CSV file path, reads it, validates the data against a JSON schema, and writes invalid rows to an error file and valid rows to an output CSV. The schema might have nested fields and type constraints. Build this in Python.

assertions.text: Includes proper error handling (try/except for file I/O, schema validation errors)
Uses type hints on all function signatures
Separates concerns into at least 3 functions (read, validate, write)
Handles the nested fields in JSON schema gracefully
Produces meaningful error messages, not generic exceptions
